text: I understand your concern about organizing the decision for your hobby group's meeting. To make this process smoother, I recommend that you ask each person whether Tuesday, Thursday, both, or neither of these days work for them, and set a deadline for them to respond. If one day turns out to be suitable for everyone, you can propose that day as the meeting time. If neither Tuesday nor Thursday works, you can share the conflict with the group and ask if they have any other suggestions. It's essential to remember that silence or not responding does not imply agreement, so be sure to confirm the final arrangement with the group once a decision has been made.
